高考英语3500词 · 03英文原文

A Hard Trip

一次艰苦的旅行 · 180 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1My sister was fond of traveling. Ever since graduating, she had been determined to organize a trip to an old temple. Since transport was expensive, she decided to go by bicycle despite the disadvantages. Her stubborn attitude had always been one of her shortcomings. Once she made up her mind to do something, no one could persuade her to change her mind. Finally, we gave in as usual though we preferred to take a train. After making a schedule, checking a reliable weather forecast and arranging insurance, we began our trip.

2Our journey was along a river flowing from a high altitude. Our pace was slow because the river took sharp bends through deep valleys, where the water seemed to boil. Just as I recorded in my journal, it was really a hard journey. But we also enjoyed great views. One night, I lay beneath the stars with my head resting on a parcel of wool coats that served as my pillow. When the flame in front of our cave went out at midnight, I found the sky so beautiful!

高考英语3500词 · 03中文译文

一次艰苦的旅行

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1我妹妹很喜欢旅行。从毕业起，她就打定主意要组织一次去古庙的旅行。车费太贵，她便决定骑自行车去，对这种办法的种种不便毫不在意。固执一向是她的缺点。她一旦下定决心，就没人能劝她改主意。我们本来更想坐火车，最后还是像往常一样让了步。拟好日程、查了可靠的天气预报、买好保险后，我们出发了。

2我们沿着一条从高处流下来的河前行。河水穿过深谷时，常常拐过很急的弯，看起来像在沸腾，所以我们走得很慢。正如我在日记里写的，这趟旅行确实辛苦。不过，我们也看到了许多美景。有天晚上，我躺在星空下，头枕着一包羊毛大衣。半夜，洞口的火熄灭了，那时我才发现天空竟然这么美！
